queries.query: When does the library open on weekdays?

excerpts.title: Fictional Library Guide
excerpts.text: The fictional library opens weekdays from 8 am to 10 pm and weekends from 10 am to 6 pm. Exam week hours may change. Confirm current hours with the library desk.

excerpts.title: Fictional Library Guide

excerpts.text: The fictional Career Center offers resume reviews on Tuesdays from 2 to 4 pm. Students can book a 20 minute appointment through the Career Center desk. Bring a printed resume and a list of target roles.
